english.note: This is the everyday all-purpose verb for putting up a notice or posting content online: it can mean physically attaching a notice, or posting a message or image online.
Use this for physically attaching or affixing something to a surface, especially with glue or adhesive.

examples.english: Remember to post the notice at the entrance.
examples.traditional: 你記得將張通告貼喺門口。
examples.jyutping: nei5 gei3 dak1 zoeng1 zoeng1 tung1 gou3 tip3 hai2 mun4 hau2

examples.english: I use tape to fix the poster to the wall.
examples.traditional: 我用膠紙將張海報貼喺牆上。
